cards.name: Gemini 4 Argon / Google reported benchmarks
cards.question: What does Google's model card report for Gemini 4 Argon?
cards.tests: Select one benchmark from the October model card. Its 19 measurements span separate tasks, metrics and protocols; Google self-computes some and reproduces external boards for others.
cards.matters: The new model can be inspected without treating results from different evaluators, tasks or harnesses as one ranking.
cards.read: These are selected Argon observations, not a complete refreshed leaderboard. Each selector changes the benchmark or measurement; rows are never pooled across benchmarks. Exact run dates, generic cost/time and numerical uncertainty are unknown. Announcement on September 30, broad availability on October 13 and source review on October 15 are different dates. External results reproduced by Google are explicitly attributed, not claimed independently checked against those boards.

cards.question: What did Artificial Analysis measure for Gemini 4 Argon?
cards.tests: Select an AA benchmark for the high-reasoning Argon configuration evaluated with Long Decode Continuation. The article reports 10 distinct measurements, with index points, Elo and percentages kept separate.
cards.matters: The new model can be inspected without treating results from different evaluators, tasks or harnesses as one ranking.
cards.read: These are selected Argon observations, not a complete refreshed leaderboard. Each selector changes the benchmark or measurement; rows are never pooled across benchmarks. Exact run dates, generic cost/time and numerical uncertainty are unknown. Announcement on September 30, broad availability on October 13 and source review on October 15 are different dates. AA's AutomationBench-AA 78% differs from Google's private-set 51.3%; AA's rounded Terminal result 57% differs from Google's 57.4%. The 53-point Intelligence Index result is directly reported; the $1.99 introductory index-task cost is kept only in that setup's details.
